name: Sato Shoji Corporation
summary: Sato Shoji Corporation sells iron and steel products, non-ferrous metals, machines, electronic materials, industrial tools, lifestyle goods, precious metals and jewelry, construction materials, and environment-related goods in Japan. The company offers surface-treated steel sheets, cold-rolled steel sheets, pickled steel sheets, hot-rolled steel sheets, steel bars and bar steel, structural carbon steel sheets, structural carbon steel, structural alloy steel and tool steel, as well as construction materials and equipment mainly to the automobile, construction and agricultural machinery, building, electrical machinery, shipbuilding, and mold and die industries.
